associations.rationale: The formal type directly states or defines the item: The projective dimension of a module, valued in extended natural numbers.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: An auxiliary extended-natural-valued invariant of a module used to characterize projective dimension.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: For a nonzero module, the projective dimension equals the auxiliary module invariant.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: A module has projective dimension zero exactly when it is projective.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: A zero module has projective dimension zero.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The projective dimension is at most a natural number exactly when the module has projective dimension bounded by that number.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: Zero is at most the projective dimension of every module.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: For a nonzero module, zero is at most the auxiliary module invariant.
